source.text: עַל־מִשְׁמַרְתִּ֣י אֶעֱמֹ֔דָה וְאֶֽתְיַצְּבָ֖ה עַל־מָצ֑וֹר וַאֲצַפֶּ֗ה לִרְאוֹת֙ מַה־יְדַבֶּר־בִּ֔י וּמָ֥ה אָשִׁ֖יב עַל־תּוֹכַחְתִּֽי׃

records.literal_gloss: At my watchpost I will stand, and I will station myself on [the] rampart, and I will watch to see what he will speak to me, and what I will answer concerning my complaint.

en.L: At my watchpost I will stand, \q and I will station myself on [the] rampart; \q and I will look out to see what {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} will speak with me, \q and what I will reply concerning my complaint.
en.B: I will stand at my watchpost \q and take my place on the rampart. \q I will look out to learn what {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} will say to me, \q and how I should answer about my complaint.
en.R: I will stand guard at my post \q and wait on the city wall. \q I will watch to see what {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} will say to me, \q and what I should say about my complaint.

fr.L: À mon poste de garde je me tiendrai, \q et je me placerai sur le rempart ; \q et je guetterai pour voir ce qu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} me dira, \q et ce que je répondrai au sujet de ma plainte.
fr.B: Je me tiendrai à mon poste de garde \q et je prendrai place sur le rempart. \q Je guetterai pour savoir ce qu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} me dira, \q et ce que je devrai répondre au sujet de ma plainte.
fr.R: Je vais monter la garde à mon poste \q et attendre sur la muraille de la ville. \q Je guetterai pour voir ce que {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} va me dire, \q et ce que je devrai dire au sujet de ma plainte.

es.L: En mi puesto de guardia estaré, \q y me apostaré sobre [la] muralla; \q y vigilaré para ver qué me dirá {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}}, \q y qué responderé acerca de mi queja.
es.B: Me mantendré en mi puesto de guardia \q y ocuparé mi lugar sobre la muralla. \q Vigilaré para saber qué me dirá {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}}, \q y cómo debo responder acerca de mi queja.
es.R: Me quedaré vigilando en mi puesto \q y esperaré sobre la muralla de la ciudad. \q Estaré atento para ver qué me dirá {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} \q y qué debo decir acerca de mi queja.

sw.L: Katika kituo changu cha ulinzi nitasimama, \q nami nitajiweka juu ya boma; \q nami nitatazama nione {{deity_pronoun:yeye|Yeye}} atakachosema nami, \q na nitakachojibu kuhusu malalamiko yangu.
sw.B: Nitasimama katika kituo changu cha ulinzi \q na kukaa mahali pangu juu ya boma. \q Nitatazama nijue atakachoniambia, \q na jinsi nitakavyojibu kuhusu malalamiko yangu.
sw.R: Nitasimama zamu katika kituo changu \q na kungoja juu ya ukuta wa mji. \q Nitatazama nione {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} atakachoniambia, \q na nitakachosema kuhusu malalamiko yangu.

vi.L: Tôi sẽ đứng tại chòi canh của tôi, \q và tôi sẽ đứng vững trên tường lũy; \q tôi sẽ trông xem {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} sẽ nói gì với tôi, \q và tôi sẽ đáp lại thế nào về lời than phiền của tôi.
vi.B: Tôi sẽ đứng nơi chòi canh \q và giữ vị trí mình trên tường lũy. \q Tôi sẽ trông chờ xem {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} sẽ phán gì với tôi, \q và tôi nên đáp lại thế nào về lời than phiền của mình.
vi.R: Tôi sẽ đứng canh tại vị trí của mình \q và chờ đợi trên tường thành. \q Tôi sẽ trông chờ xem {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} sẽ phán gì với tôi, \q và tôi nên nói gì về lời than phiền của tôi.

ko.L: 내가 나의 파수하는 곳에 서고, \q 성루 위에 자리를 잡겠다. \q 그리고 그분께서 나에게 무엇을 말씀하실지, \q 나의 호소에 대하여 내가 무엇이라고 대답할지 지켜보겠다.
ko.B: 나는 내 파수하는 자리에 서고, \q 성루 위에 자리를 잡겠다. \q 그분께서 나에게 무엇이라고 말씀하실지, \q 내 호소에 대하여 내가 어떻게 대답해야 할지 살펴보겠다.
ko.R: 나는 내 자리에 서서 망을 보겠다. \q 성벽 위에서 기다리겠다. \q {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 나에게 무엇이라고 말씀하실지, \q 내 호소에 대하여 내가 무엇이라고 말해야 할지 지켜보겠다.

pt.L: Na minha guarita ficarei de pé, \q e me posicionarei sobre [a] muralha; \q e vigiarei para ver o que {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} falará comigo \q e o que responderei quanto à minha queixa.
pt.B: Ficarei no meu posto de vigia \q e tomarei o meu lugar sobre a muralha. \q Vigiarei para saber o que {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} me dirá \q e como devo responder quanto à minha queixa.
pt.R: Vou ficar de guarda no meu posto \q e esperar em cima da muralha da cidade. \q Vou vigiar para ver o que {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} vai me dizer \q e o que devo dizer sobre a minha queixa.

am.L: በመጠበቂያ ስፍራዬ እቆማለሁ፤ \q በቅጥሩም ላይ ራሴን አቆማለሁ፤ \q ከእኔ ጋር ምን እንደሚናገር ለማየት እጠባበቃለሁ፤ \q ስለ ክርክሬም ምን እንደምመልስ።
am.B: በመጠበቂያ ስፍራዬ እቆማለሁ፤ \q በቅጥሩም ላይ ቦታዬን እይዛለሁ። \q ምን እንደሚለኝ፣ \q ስለ ክርክሬም ምን መመለስ እንዳለብኝ ለማወቅ እጠባበቃለሁ።
am.R: በመጠበቂያዬ ላይ ዘብ እቆማለሁ፤ \q በከተማዪቱም ቅጥር ላይ እጠብቃለሁ። \q {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ምን እንደሚለኝ፣ \q ስለ ክርክሬም ምን ማለት እንዳለብኝ ለማየት እጠባበቃለሁ።

hi.L: मैं अपने पहरे के स्थान पर खड़ा रहूँगा, \q और गढ़ की दीवार पर डटा रहूँगा; \q और ताकता रहूँगा कि देखूँ वे मुझसे क्या कहेंगे, \q और मैं अपनी शिकायत के विषय में क्या उत्तर दूँगा।
hi.B: मैं अपने पहरे की चौकी पर खड़ा रहूँगा \q और गढ़ की दीवार पर अपना स्थान लूँगा। \q मैं ताक लगाए रहूँगा कि जानूँ वे मुझसे क्या कहेंगे, \q और मुझे अपनी शिकायत के बारे में क्या उत्तर देना चाहिए।
hi.R: मैं अपनी चौकी पर पहरा दूँगा \q और नगर की दीवार पर प्रतीक्षा करूँगा। \q मैं देखता रहूँगा कि {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} मुझसे क्या कहेंगे, \q और मुझे अपनी शिकायत के बारे में क्या कहना चाहिए।

ru.L: На моём посту я встану, \q и стану на валу, \q и буду высматривать, что {{deity_pronoun:он|Он}} скажет мне \q и что я отвечу на мою жалобу.
ru.B: Я встану на мой пост \q и займу место на крепостной стене. \q Я буду высматривать, что {{deity_pronoun:он|Он}} скажет мне \q и как мне ответить на мою жалобу.
ru.R: Я встану на страже на моём посту \q и буду ждать на городской стене. \q Я буду смотреть, что скажет мне {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}} \q и что мне сказать о моей жалобе.

ja.L: わたしは自分の見張り所に立ち、 \q 砦の上に身を据えよう。 \q そして見張っていよう。その方がわたしに何を語られるか、 \q わたしの訴えについて、わたしが何と答えるかを見るために。
ja.B: わたしは見張り所に立ち、 \q 砦の上に持ち場を取ろう。 \q その方がわたしに何と言われるか、 \q わたしの訴えについてどう答えるべきかを知ろうと、見張っていよう。
ja.R: わたしは見張りの持ち場に立ち、 \q 町の城壁の上で待とう。 \q {{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}がわたしに何を言われるか、 \q わたしの訴えについて、わたしが何と言えばよいのかを見ようと、見張っていよう。

uk.L: На своїй варті я стоятиму \q і стану на валу; \q і виглядатиму, щоб побачити, що {{deity_pronoun:він|Він}} скаже мені \q і що я відповім на свою скаргу.
uk.B: Я стоятиму на своїй варті \q і займу своє місце на валу. \q Я виглядатиму, щоб дізнатися, що {{deity_pronoun:він|Він}} скаже мені \q і як мені відповісти на мою скаргу.
uk.R: Я стоятиму на своєму посту \q і чекатиму на міському мурі. \q Я виглядатиму, щоб побачити, що скаже мені {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}}, \q і що мені сказати про мою скаргу.

decisions.choice: my watchpost ... the rampart: the prophet as a watchman
decisions.reason: A watchman stood on the wall to look out for messengers or danger and report what he saw (2 Samuel 18:24-27; Isaiah 21:6-8). The prophets call themselves watchmen for God's word (Jeremiah 6:17; Ezekiel 3:17). Habakkuk will wait for the LORD's answer as a sentry waits for news; he may also mean a real place of prayer and watching.

decisions.choice: what I will answer concerning my complaint
alternatives: what I will answer when I am corrected
decisions.reason: The word translated "complaint" can also mean "rebuke" or "correction". The line may mean what Habakkuk will say when God answers his complaint, or how he should respond when God corrects him. Either way he expects God to answer.

decisions.choice: the LORD
decisions.reason: Readable names the LORD as the "he" who will speak.

decisions.choice: "mi puesto de guardia"
decisions.reason: The term sheet keeps "centinela" for the watchman and uses "puesto de guardia" for the post here; the word stays the same at every level.

decisions.choice: "kituo changu cha ulinzi", "boma"
decisions.reason: The prophet pictures himself as a watchman, as Isaiah 21:8 ("kituo changu"); "boma" is the rampart of a city wall. At Balanced the pronoun is carried by the verb ("atakachoniambia"), so there is no deity_pronoun span there.

decisions.choice: Habakkuk speaks about God in the plain written style with -시- and "그분" (L, B; R names the LORD as the English R does), and to God in 합쇼체
decisions.reason: Here the prophet is no longer addressing God but telling what he will do, so the narrative style holds, as in the psalms where the speaker turns from God to the hearers.

decisions.choice: the prophet speaks of himself as "tôi" here
decisions.reason: Habakkuk is no longer speaking to God but telling what he will do, so the narrative "tôi" is used, as the terms note gives for the prophet's own voice; he says "con" when he speaks to God (1:2-17).

decisions.choice: no deity_pronoun spans in Amharic
decisions.reason: The Ethiopic script has no capital letters, so the setting that capitalizes pronouns for God has nothing to change; the English spans on the pronouns for God in this chapter have no Amharic counterpart, and pronouns and verb forms for God are written plainly.

decisions.choice: "to see" moves to the last line: "… ምን እንደሚለኝ፣ / ስለ ክርክሬም … ለማወቅ እጠባበቃለሁ" (B, R)
decisions.reason: Amharic puts the verb at the end, so Balanced and Readable gather both questions under one "I will watch to learn" in the last line; Literal keeps the Hebrew order, with the second question added after the verb.

decisions.choice: No deity_pronoun spans in Hindi
decisions.reason: Where the English marks God's pronouns with the deity_pronoun setting, the Hindi has no span; God in the third person is honorific (वे ... कहेंगे). Readable names the LORD, as the English Readable does.

decisions.choice: mishmarti "見張り所" (L, B), "見張りの持ち場" (R); matsor "砦" (L, B), "町の城壁" (R); tokhachti "わたしの訴え"; God in the third person "その方" with the respect form "語られる / 言われる".
decisions.reason: The prophet pictures himself as a watchman (m1); God is never 彼 (ISA-ISA-1). The line order of the last two lines is kept by putting "見張っていよう" first at L.

source.text: וַיַּעֲנֵ֤נִי יְהוָה֙ וַיֹּ֔אמֶר כְּת֣וֹב חָז֔וֹן וּבָאֵ֖ר עַל־הַלֻּח֑וֹת לְמַ֥עַן יָר֖וּץ ק֥וֹרֵא בֽוֹ׃

records.literal_gloss: And answered me Yahweh and said: Write [the] vision, and make [it] plain on the tablets, so that may run [one who] reads it.

en.L: And {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} answered me and said: \q Write [the] vision; make [it] plain on the tablets, \q so that one who reads it may run.
en.B: Then {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} answered me: \q Write down the vision; make it plain on tablets, \q so that whoever reads it can run.
en.R: Then {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} answered me: \q Write down the vision. Make it clear on tablets \q so that whoever reads it can run with the message.

fr.L: Et {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} me répondit et dit : \q Écris [la] vision ; grave-[la] clairement sur les tablettes, \q afin que celui qui la lit puisse courir.
fr.B: Alors {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} me répondit : \q Écris la vision ; grave-la clairement sur des tablettes, \q pour que celui qui la lit puisse courir.
fr.R: Alors {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} m’a répondu : \q Écris la vision. Grave-la bien lisiblement sur des tablettes, \q pour que celui qui la lit puisse courir transmettre le message.

es.L: Y me respondió {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, y dijo: \q Escribe [la] visión, y grába[la] con claridad en las tablas, \q para que pueda correr el que la lea.
es.B: Entonces {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} me respondió: \q Escribe la visión; grábala con claridad en tablas, \q para que quien la lea pueda correr.
es.R: Entonces {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} me respondió: \q Escribe la visión. Ponla con letras claras en unas tablas \q para que quien la lea pueda correr a llevar el mensaje.

sw.L: Na {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} akanijibu, akasema: \q Andika maono; yaandike waziwazi juu ya vibao, \q ili msomaji wake apate kukimbia.
sw.B: Ndipo {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} akanijibu: \q Yaandike maono; yaandike waziwazi juu ya vibao, \q ili kila anayeyasoma aweze kukimbia.
sw.R: Ndipo {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} akanijibu: \q Yaandike maono. Yaandike wazi juu ya vibao \q ili kila anayeyasoma aweze kukimbia kuupeleka ujumbe.

vi.L: Và {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đáp lời tôi và phán: \q Hãy viết khải tượng; hãy ghi [nó] cho rõ trên các bảng, \q để người đọc nó có thể chạy.
vi.B: Bấy giờ {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đáp lời tôi: \q Hãy viết khải tượng ra; hãy ghi rõ ràng trên các bảng, \q để ai đọc cũng có thể chạy đi.
vi.R: Bấy giờ {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đáp lời tôi: \q Hãy viết khải tượng ra. Hãy ghi thật rõ trên các bảng \q để ai đọc cũng có thể chạy đi loan báo sứ điệp ấy.

ko.L: 그러자 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 나에게 대답하여 말씀하셨다. \q 환상을 기록하여라. 판들 위에 [그것을] 분명하게 새겨라. \q 그것을 읽는 자가 달려갈 수 있도록 하여라.
ko.B: 그러자 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 나에게 대답하셨다. \q 이 환상을 기록하여라. 판에 분명하게 새겨서 \q 읽는 사람이 누구든지 달려갈 수 있게 하여라.
ko.R: 그러자 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 나에게 대답하셨다. \q 이 환상을 적어라. 판에 알아보기 쉽게 새겨라. \q 그래서 그것을 읽는 사람이 달려가서 이 소식을 전할 수 있게 하여라.

pt.L: E {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} me respondeu e disse: \q Escreve [a] visão e deixa[-a] clara nas tábuas, \q para que corra quem a lê.
pt.B: Então {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} me respondeu: \q Põe a visão por escrito; deixa-a bem clara em tábuas, \q para que quem a ler possa correr.
pt.R: Então {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} me respondeu: \q Põe a visão por escrito. Escreve tudo de forma clara em tábuas, \q para que quem a ler possa correr para levar a mensagem.

am.L: {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}}ም መለሰልኝ፤ እንዲህም አለ፦ \q ራእዩን ጻፍ፤ በጽላቶቹም ላይ ግልጽ አድርገው፤ \q የሚያነበው ይሮጥ ዘንድ።
am.B: {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}}ም እንዲህ ብሎ መለሰልኝ፦ \q ራእዩን ጻፈው፤ በጽላት ላይ ግልጽ አድርገው፤ \q የሚያነበው ሁሉ መሮጥ እንዲችል።
am.R: ከዚያም {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} እንዲህ ብሎ መለሰልኝ፦ \q ራእዩን ጻፈው። በጽላት ላይ ግልጽ አድርገህ ጻፈው፤ \q የሚያነበው ሁሉ መልእክቱን ይዞ እንዲሮጥ።

hi.L: और {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} ने मुझे उत्तर दिया और कहा: \q दर्शन को लिखो; उसे पटियाओं पर साफ़-साफ़ लिखो, \q ताकि जो उसे पढ़े वह दौड़ सके।
hi.B: तब {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} ने मुझे उत्तर दिया: \q दर्शन को लिख लो; उसे पटियाओं पर साफ़-साफ़ लिखो, \q ताकि जो कोई उसे पढ़े, वह दौड़ सके।
hi.R: तब {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} ने मुझे उत्तर दिया: \q दर्शन को लिख लो। उसे पटियाओं पर साफ़-साफ़ लिखो, \q ताकि जो कोई उसे पढ़े, वह संदेश लेकर दौड़ सके।

ru.L: И ответил мне {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}} и сказал: \q Запиши видение и начертай [его] ясно на скрижалях, \q чтобы читающий его мог бежать.
ru.B: Тогда {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}} ответил мне: \q Запиши видение, напиши его ясно на табличках, \q чтобы тот, кто прочтёт, мог бежать.
ru.R: Тогда {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}} ответил мне: \q Запиши видение. Напиши его разборчиво на табличках, \q чтобы тот, кто его прочтёт, мог бежать и передавать весть.

ja.L: {{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}はわたしに答えて言われた。 \q 幻を書き記せ。板の上にはっきりと記せ。 \q それを読む者が走ることができるように。
ja.B: すると、{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}はわたしに答えられた。 \q 幻を書き記しなさい。板の上にはっきりと記しなさい。 \q それを読む者が走ることができるように。
ja.R: すると、{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}がわたしに答えられた。 \q 幻を書き記しなさい。板の上にわかりやすく書きなさい。 \q それを読む人が、その知らせを持って走って行けるように。

uk.L: І відповів мені {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}}, і сказав: \q Запиши видіння; зроби [його] виразним на таблицях, \q щоб міг бігти той, хто його читає.
uk.B: Тоді {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}} відповів мені: \q Запиши видіння; напиши його ясно на таблицях, \q щоб той, хто його читає, міг бігти.
uk.R: Тоді {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}} відповів мені: \q Запиши видіння. Напиши його ясно на таблицях, \q щоб той, хто його прочитає, міг бігти з цією звісткою.

decisions.choice: write the vision ... on the tablets: a public, lasting record
decisions.reason: Tablets were flat pieces of clay, wood or stone used for writing. A message written on tablets could be set up for all to read and kept as a witness that the LORD had said it beforehand (Isaiah 8:1; 30:8). "Make it plain" is used of writing the law clearly on stones in Deuteronomy 27:8.

decisions.choice: so that one who reads it may run
alternatives: so that it can be read at a glance
decisions.reason: The phrase may mean that a messenger who reads it can run to spread it, as prophets are said to "run" with God's word (Jeremiah 23:21), or that it is so plain that a passer-by can read it at a glance. Both readings stress that the message must be clear and spread.

decisions.choice: run with the message
decisions.reason: Readable adds "with the message" to make the running clear, following the first reading of m2; the second is noted there.

decisions.choice: "me répondit" (L, B), "m'a répondu" (R) for the short narrative frame; the LORD's answer takes no quotation marks
decisions.reason: The one line of narration in the book follows the narrative rule (passé simple at L and B); God's answer is an oracle and, as in the English, takes no quotation marks.

decisions.choice: "grábala con claridad" (L, B); "ponla con letras claras" (R)
decisions.reason: The verb means to make the writing distinct, as on a tablet; Spanish says "grabar con claridad" at L and B and plainer words at R.

decisions.choice: no quotation marks
decisions.reason: God's answer is an oracle, so it takes no quotation marks, as the Spanish prophets set.

decisions.choice: "vibao"
decisions.reason: Tablets for writing: "vibao" are small boards or tablets set up for public reading, which the meaning decision describes.

decisions.choice: God's reply takes no quotation marks and no second-person pronoun
decisions.reason: God's oracle is not set in quotation marks (terms note); the commands "Hãy viết" need no pronoun, so the choice between "ngươi" and "con" does not arise in this verse.

decisions.choice: tu (God to Habakkuk); no quotation marks
decisions.reason: The LORD speaks to the prophet alone, so every level says "tu" ("Escreve", "deixa"), as God speaks to one person in the Old Testament. As in the English, his answer follows a colon without quotation marks, as the prophets' "Assim diz o SENHOR" does.

decisions.choice: God's words after "እንዲህ አለ፦" with no guillemets
decisions.reason: The English sets God's answer (2:2–20) as the body of the book with no quotation marks, so the Amharic introduces it with "፦" and no « », as Job's speeches are set; the quotation structure stays that of the English.

decisions.choice: God's answer has no quotation marks (as the English); his commands to the prophet inside the verse take the oracle forms "〜せよ" (L), "〜しなさい" (B, R); chazon "幻"; luchot "板".
decisions.reason: The Jeremiah convention: inside a verse oracle God's commands use the oracle forms (JER-JER-1).

source.text: כִּ֣י ע֤וֹד חָזוֹן֙ לַמּוֹעֵ֔ד וְיָפֵ֥חַ לַקֵּ֖ץ וְלֹ֣א יְכַזֵּ֑ב אִם־יִתְמַהְמָהּ֙ חַכֵּה־ל֔וֹ כִּֽי־בֹ֥א יָבֹ֖א לֹ֥א יְאַחֵֽר׃

records.literal_gloss: For still [the] vision [is] for the appointed time, and it hastens to the end, and not will it lie; if it delays, wait for it; for surely it will come; not will it be late.

en.L: For still [the] vision [is] for the appointed time; \q it hastens to the end, and it will not lie. \q If it delays, wait for it; \q for it will surely come; it will not be late.
en.B: For the vision still waits for its appointed time; \q it hurries toward the end and will not prove false. \q Though it lingers, wait for it; \q it will certainly come and will not be late.
en.R: The vision is for a time that God has set. \q It is hurrying toward the end, and it will not fail. \q If it seems slow in coming, wait for it. \q It will surely come. It will not be late.

fr.L: Car la vision [est] encore pour le temps fixé ; \q elle se hâte vers la fin, et elle ne mentira pas. \q Si elle tarde, attends-la ; \q car elle viendra sûrement ; elle ne sera pas en retard.
fr.B: Car la vision attend encore le moment fixé ; \q elle se hâte vers la fin et ne décevra pas. \q Même si elle se fait attendre, attends-la ; \q elle viendra certainement, elle ne tardera pas.
fr.R: La vision est pour un moment que Dieu a fixé. \q Elle se dépêche vers la fin, et elle ne manquera pas de se réaliser. \q Si elle te semble lente à venir, attends-la. \q Elle viendra sûrement. Elle ne sera pas en retard.

es.L: Porque aún [es] la visión para el tiempo señalado; \q se apresura hacia el fin, y no mentirá. \q Si se retrasa, espérala; \q porque ciertamente vendrá; no tardará.
es.B: Porque la visión aún espera su tiempo señalado; \q se apresura hacia el fin y no resultará falsa. \q Aunque se demore, espérala; \q sin falta vendrá y no se retrasará.
es.R: La visión es para un tiempo que Dios ha fijado. \q Se apresura hacia el fin, y no fallará. \q Si parece que tarda, espérala. \q Vendrá sin falta. No llegará tarde.

sw.L: Kwa maana bado maono [ni] kwa ajili ya wakati ulioamriwa; \q yanaharakisha kuelekea mwisho, wala hayatadanganya. \q Yakikawia, yangoje; \q kwa maana hakika yatakuja; hayatachelewa.
sw.B: Kwa maana maono bado yanangoja wakati wake ulioamriwa; \q yanaharakisha kuelekea mwisho, wala hayatakuwa ya uongo. \q Ingawa yanakawia, yangoje; \q hakika yatakuja, wala hayatachelewa.
sw.R: Maono haya ni kwa ajili ya wakati ambao Mungu ameuweka. \q Yanaharakisha kuelekea mwisho, wala hayatashindwa. \q Yakionekana kuchelewa, yangoje. \q Hakika yatakuja. Hayatachelewa.

vi.L: Vì khải tượng còn [dành] cho kỳ đã định; \q nó vội vã đến sự cuối cùng, và nó sẽ không dối gạt. \q Nếu nó chậm trễ, hãy đợi nó; \q vì nó chắc chắn sẽ đến; nó sẽ không trễ.
vi.B: Vì khải tượng vẫn còn chờ đến kỳ đã định; \q nó đang hối hả đến hồi cuối cùng và sẽ không sai lời. \q Dù nó có chậm trễ, hãy chờ đợi; \q vì chắc chắn nó sẽ đến, không trễ hẹn đâu.
vi.R: Khải tượng này dành cho một thời điểm Đức Chúa Trời đã định. \q Nó đang vội đến hồi kết, và nó sẽ không sai. \q Nếu nó có vẻ chậm đến, hãy chờ đợi. \q Chắc chắn nó sẽ đến. Nó sẽ không trễ.

ko.L: 이 환상은 아직 정해진 때를 위한 것이다. \q 그것은 끝을 향해 서두르며 거짓말을 하지 않는다. \q 그것이 더디더라도 그것을 기다려라. \q 그것이 반드시 올 것이며, 늦어지지 않을 것이다.
ko.B: 이 환상은 정해진 때를 기다리고 있다. \q 그것은 끝을 향해 서둘러 가며, 결코 헛되지 않을 것이다. \q 더디어 보여도 기다려라. \q 그것은 반드시 오고, 늦어지지 않을 것이다.
ko.R: 이 환상은 하나님께서 정하신 때를 위한 것이다. \q 그것은 끝을 향해 서둘러 가고 있으며, 틀림없이 이루어질 것이다. \q 더디게 오는 것 같아도 기다려라. \q 그것은 반드시 온다. 늦어지지 않을 것이다.

pt.L: Pois ainda [há] visão para o tempo marcado; \q ela anseia pelo fim e não mentirá. \q Se ela se demorar, aguarda-a, \q pois vir, virá; não tardará.
pt.B: Pois a visão ainda espera o seu tempo marcado; \q ela corre para o fim e não se mostrará falsa. \q Ainda que pareça demorar, espera por ela; \q ela virá sem falta e não tardará.
pt.R: A visão é para um tempo que Deus marcou. \q Ela está correndo para o fim, e não vai falhar. \q Se parecer que está demorando, espera. \q Ela vai chegar com certeza. Não vai se atrasar.

am.L: ራእዩ ገና ለቀጠሮው ጊዜ ነውና፤ \q ወደ መጨረሻው ይገሠግሣል፤ ሐሰትም አይሆንም። \q ቢቆይም ተጠባበቀው፤ \q በእርግጥ ይመጣልና፤ አይዘገይም።
am.B: ራእዩ ገና የቀጠሮውን ጊዜ ይጠብቃልና፤ \q ወደ ፍጻሜው ይፋጠናል፤ ሐሰት ሆኖም አይገኝም። \q ቢቆይ እንኳ ጠብቀው፤ \q ያለ ጥርጥር ይመጣል፤ አይዘገይም።
am.R: ራእዩ እግዚአብሔር ለወሰነው ጊዜ ነው። \q ወደ ፍጻሜው እየተጣደፈ ነው፤ ሳይፈጸምም አይቀርም። \q የዘገየ ቢመስልም ጠብቀው። \q በእርግጥ ይመጣል። አይዘገይም።

hi.L: क्योंकि दर्शन अब भी ठहराए हुए समय के लिए [है]; \q वह अंत की ओर फुर्ती करता है, और झूठा न ठहरेगा। \q यदि वह ठहरा रहे, तो उसकी बाट जोहो; \q क्योंकि वह निश्चय आएगा; वह देर न करेगा।
hi.B: क्योंकि दर्शन अब भी अपने ठहराए हुए समय की प्रतीक्षा में है; \q वह अंत की ओर तेज़ी से बढ़ता है और झूठा न निकलेगा। \q चाहे उसमें देर लगे, तो भी उसकी बाट जोहो; \q वह निश्चय आएगा और देर न करेगा।
hi.R: यह दर्शन उस समय के लिए है जिसे परमेश्वर ने ठहराया है। \q वह अंत की ओर तेज़ी से बढ़ रहा है, और वह विफल नहीं होगा। \q यदि उसके आने में देर लगती दिखे, तो उसकी प्रतीक्षा करो। \q वह निश्चय आएगा। वह देर नहीं करेगा।

ru.L: Потому что ещё видение — на назначенное время, \q и спешит к концу, и не обманет. \q Если замедлит, жди его, \q потому что непременно придёт, не опоздает.
ru.B: Ведь видение ещё ждёт своего назначенного времени; \q оно спешит к концу и не окажется ложным. \q Если оно медлит, жди его: \q оно непременно придёт и не опоздает.
ru.R: Видение — о времени, которое назначил Бог. \q Оно спешит к концу, и оно не обманет. \q Если кажется, что оно медлит, жди его. \q Оно непременно придёт. Оно не опоздает.

ja.L: まことに、幻はなお定めの時のためにある。 \q それは終わりに向かって急ぎ、偽らない。 \q もし遅くなっても、それを待て。 \q それは必ず来る。遅れることはない。
ja.B: 幻は、なおその定められた時を待っている。 \q それは終わりに向かって急ぎ、偽りとはならない。 \q たとえ遅くなっても、それを待ちなさい。 \q それは必ず来る。遅れることはない。
ja.R: この幻は、神が定めた時のためのものだ。 \q それは終わりに向かって急いでいて、外れることはない。 \q もし来るのが遅いように思えても、待っていなさい。 \q それは必ず来る。遅れることはない。

uk.L: Бо ще видіння [—] на призначений час; \q воно поспішає до кінця, і не обмане. \q Якщо барится, чекай його; \q бо неодмінно прийде, не запізниться.
uk.B: Бо видіння ще чекає свого призначеного часу; \q воно поспішає до кінця і не виявиться неправдою. \q Хоч воно й барится, чекай його; \q воно неодмінно прийде й не запізниться.
uk.R: Видіння — для часу, який призначив Бог. \q Воно поспішає до кінця і не підведе. \q Якщо здається, що воно барится, чекай його. \q Воно неодмінно прийде. Воно не запізниться.

decisions.choice: the appointed time ... it hastens to the end
decisions.reason: The vision speaks of a time God has fixed, and of the "end", the time of fulfillment (compare Daniel 8:19; 10:14). The verb may mean "pant" or "hasten" toward it; with a different sense of a word of the same form, it may mean that the vision "testifies" of the end (Proverbs 6:19).

decisions.choice: it will surely come; it will not be late
decisions.reason: "It" is the vision, or what the vision announces. The verb is doubled for certainty: it will come without fail, even if it seems slow. In Hebrew the same words could be read "he will surely come", and the Greek translation read them of a person. Hebrews 10:37 quotes the Greek of this line, "the one who is coming will come and will not delay", before quoting verse 4.

decisions.choice: a time that God has set
decisions.reason: Readable says who appointed the time.

decisions.choice: vir, virá; não tardará (L); virá sem falta e não tardará (B); Ela vai chegar com certeza. Não vai se atrasar (R)
decisions.reason: Hebrews 10:37 echoes this line from the Greek translation, which reads it of a person, "aquele que vem virá e não tardará" (m2). Habakkuk follows the Hebrew, where "it" is the vision, and keeps the words the two share, "virá" and "não tardará" (L, B). Literal shows the doubled verb with "vir, virá".

decisions.choice: "ይመጣል … አይዘገይም" with the vision as subject
alternatives: "የሚመጣው ይመጣል" (the coming one will come, Hebrews 10:37)
decisions.reason: Hebrews 10:37 quotes this line in its Greek form, where a person is coming ("የሚመጣው ይመጣል፤ አይዘገይምም"). The Hebrew speaks of the vision, so the Amharic follows the Hebrew and keeps only the verbs of Hebrews' Amharic, "ይመጣል" and "አይዘገይም". The Hebrew uses two verbs for delay; "ቢቆይ" (if it lingers) is kept apart from "አይዘገይም" (it will not be late). Readable names God as setting the time, as the English Readable.

decisions.choice: वह निश्चय आएगा; वह देर न करेगा
decisions.reason: Hebrews 10:37 quotes these words from the Greek Old Testament, which reads "the coming one will come and will not delay", of a person; the Hebrew speaks of the vision. Every level translates the Hebrew (वह, the vision) and keeps Hebrews' Hindi for the shared words, आएगा and देर न करेगा.

decisions.choice: спешит к концу
decisions.reason: The verb is taken as "hastens" ("pants toward"), as the English has it; Hebrews 10:37 draws on the next line in its Greek form.

decisions.choice: From the Hebrew: the subject is the vision, "それは必ず来る", not Hebrews 10:37's "来るべき方が来られる"; the last words "遅れることはない" are shared with the Hebrews 10:37 Japanese; mo'ed "定めの時" (L), "定められた時" (B), "神が定めた時" (R, God's own words, so no respect form).
decisions.reason: Hebrews 10:37 reads the Greek, where 'it' becomes 'he who is coming'; the meaning decisions follow the Hebrew (m2).

source.text: הִנֵּ֣ה עֻפְּלָ֔ה לֹא־יָשְׁרָ֥ה נַפְשׁ֖וֹ בּ֑וֹ וְצַדִּ֖יק בֶּאֱמוּנָת֥וֹ יִחְיֶֽה׃

records.literal_gloss: Look, puffed up, not upright [is] his soul in him; but [the] righteous by his faithfulness will live.

en.L: Look, puffed up, his soul [is] not upright within him; \q but the righteous by {{gender:their|his}} faithfulness will live.
en.B: Look at the proud one: his desires are not upright within him; \q but the righteous will live by {{gender:their|his}} faithfulness.
en.R: Look at the proud enemy. His heart is not right. \q But the person who does right will live by being faithful.

fr.L: Voici, enflée, son âme n’[est] pas droite en lui ; \q mais le juste, par sa fidélité, vivra.
fr.B: Regarde l’orgueilleux : ses désirs ne sont pas droits en lui ; \q mais le juste vivra par sa fidélité.
fr.R: Regarde l’ennemi orgueilleux. Son cœur n’est pas droit. \q Mais celui qui fait ce qui est juste vivra en restant fidèle.

es.L: Mira, el envanecido: no es recta su alma dentro de él; \q pero el justo por su fidelidad vivirá.
es.B: Mira al orgulloso: sus deseos no son rectos dentro de él; \q pero el justo vivirá por su fidelidad.
es.R: Mira al enemigo orgulloso. Su corazón no es recto. \q Pero la persona que hace lo correcto vivirá por ser fiel.

sw.L: Tazama, amejivuna, nafsi yake ndani yake si nyofu; \q lakini mwenye haki kwa uaminifu wake ataishi.
sw.B: Mtazame mwenye kiburi: tamaa zake ndani yake si nyofu; \q lakini mwenye haki ataishi kwa uaminifu wake.
sw.R: Mtazame adui mwenye kiburi. Moyo wake si mnyofu. \q Lakini mtu anayetenda haki ataishi kwa kuwa mwaminifu.

vi.L: Kìa, kẻ tự cao, linh hồn hắn không ngay thẳng trong hắn; \q nhưng người công chính bởi sự thành tín của mình sẽ sống.
vi.B: Hãy xem kẻ kiêu ngạo: lòng ham muốn của hắn không ngay thẳng; \q nhưng người công chính sẽ sống bởi sự thành tín của mình.
vi.R: Hãy xem kẻ thù kiêu ngạo. Lòng hắn không ngay thẳng. \q Nhưng người làm điều ngay thẳng sẽ sống nhờ giữ lòng trung tín.

ko.L: 보라, 교만한 자, 그의 속에 있는 그의 영혼은 바르지 않다. \q 그러나 의인은 자기의 신실함으로 살 것이다.
ko.B: 교만한 자를 보아라. 그의 속마음은 바르지 않다. \q 그러나 의로운 사람은 자기의 신실함으로 살 것이다.
ko.R: 교만한 원수를 보아라. 그의 마음은 바르지 않다. \q 그러나 바르게 사는 사람은 신실함으로 살 것이다.

pt.L: Eis que [está] inchado; a sua alma não é reta dentro dele; \q mas o justo pela sua fidelidade viverá.
pt.B: Olha o orgulhoso: os seus desejos não são retos dentro dele; \q mas o justo viverá pela sua fidelidade.
pt.R: Olha para o inimigo orgulhoso. O coração dele não é correto. \q Mas a pessoa que é justa viverá por ser fiel.

am.L: እነሆ፣ ተኩራርቷል፤ በውስጡ ያለችው ነፍሱ ቀጥተኛ አይደለችም፤ \q ጻድቅ ግን በታማኝነቱ በሕይወት ይኖራል።
am.B: ትዕቢተኛውን ተመልከት፤ ምኞቱ በውስጡ ቀጥተኛ አይደለም፤ \q ጻድቅ ግን በታማኝነቱ በሕይወት ይኖራል።
am.R: ትዕቢተኛውን ጠላት ተመልከት። ልቡ ቅን አይደለም። \q ጻድቅ የሆነ ሰው ግን ታማኝ በመሆኑ በሕይወት ይኖራል።

hi.L: देखो, फूला हुआ, उसका प्राण उसके भीतर सीधा नहीं [है]; \q पर धर्मी [जन] अपनी विश्वासयोग्यता से जीवित रहेगा।
hi.B: घमंडी को देखो: उसकी लालसाएँ उसके भीतर सीधी नहीं हैं; \q पर जो धर्मी है, वह अपनी विश्वासयोग्यता से जीवित रहेगा।
hi.R: उस घमंडी शत्रु को देखो। उसका मन सही नहीं है। \q पर जो व्यक्ति धर्मी है, वह विश्वासयोग्य बने रहने से जीवित रहेगा।

ru.L: Вот, надменна, не пряма в нём душа его; \q а праведный своей верностью будет жить.
ru.B: Вот гордец: его желания в нём не праведны; \q а праведный будет жить своей верностью.
ru.R: Посмотрите на гордого врага. Его сердце неправо. \q А человек, который праведен, будет жить, оставаясь верным.

ja.L: 見なさい、[その者は]高ぶり、その魂は彼の内でまっすぐではない。 \q しかし、正しい者は、その真実によって生きる。
ja.B: 高ぶる者を見なさい。その心の思いは正しくない。 \q しかし、正しい者は、その誠実によって生きる。
ja.R: 高ぶった敵を見なさい。その心は正しくない。 \q しかし、正しいことをする人は、神に忠実であることによって生きる。

uk.L: Ось, пихата, не пряма його душа в ньому; \q а праведний своєю вірністю житиме.
uk.B: Поглянь на гордого: його бажання не праві в ньому; \q а праведний житиме своєю вірністю.
uk.R: Поглянь на гордого ворога. Його серце неправе. \q А людина, яка чинить правильно, житиме тим, що буде вірною.

decisions.choice: puffed up, his soul is not upright within him
alternatives: if he draws back, my soul has no pleasure in him (Greek)
decisions.reason: The first line is hard. The verb is used only here and is taken to mean "swollen", that is, proud; "his soul" is his inner self and its desires. The proud one is the arrogant man of verse 5, the Babylonian, set against the righteous. The Greek translation reads the line differently: "if he draws back, my soul has no pleasure in him". Hebrews 10:38 quotes that Greek form after the second line.

decisions.choice: by his faithfulness: by steady loyalty to God, whose faithfulness is meant being uncertain
alternatives: by its faithfulness, the reliability of the vision
decisions.reason: The word (*'emunah*) means firmness, steadiness and trustworthiness: Moses' hands were "steady" (Exodus 17:12), and the word is used of God's own faithfulness (Deuteronomy 32:4; Psalm 89:2). In people it is loyal trust in God that holds firm, and shows itself in a faithful life. Here it is the righteous person's own faithfulness ("his"), in contrast to the pride of the Babylonian: the one who keeps trusting God through the coming disaster will live. The Greek translation reads "my faithfulness", that is, God's faithfulness. Some read "its", the reliability of the vision of verse 3. The Hebrew text has "his".

decisions.choice: Romans 1:17, Galatians 3:11 and Hebrews 10:38 quote this line in Greek, as "the righteous will live by faith"
decisions.reason: Paul quotes the line twice to show that people are put right with God by faith, not by keeping the law (Romans 1:17; Galatians 3:11). Hebrews 10:38 quotes it, in the Greek form "my righteous one will live by faith", to urge believers to keep trusting and not draw back. In each case the Greek word means faith or trust. The Hebrew word stresses the faithfulness that trust produces; both describe a life that rests on God and holds firm in him.

decisions.choice: the righteous: the one who is right with God and does what is right
decisions.reason: In the prophets the righteous person is one who is loyal to God and lives by his ways (Ezekiel 18:5-9). In this book the righteous are those wronged by the wicked (1:4, 13).

decisions.choice: by their faithfulness (L, B); by being faithful (R); not "faith"
decisions.reason: The settled wording for this verse. Literal and Balanced say "faithfulness", not "faith", because the Hebrew word means steady loyalty (m2); the New Testament quotations are translated from their Greek, where the word is "faith" (m3). "The righteous" means any righteous person, man or woman, so the pronoun is a gender span. Readable says "the person who does right" and "by being faithful".

decisions.choice: the proud one (B); the proud enemy (R); desires, heart (B, R)
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable say who is "puffed up" (m1). "Soul" here is the inner self; Balanced says "desires" and Readable "heart".

decisions.choice: "sa fidélité" with no gender span, where the English has {{gender:their|his}}
decisions.reason: The French possessive "sa" agrees with "fidélité" and says nothing about the sex of the righteous person, so French needs no gender setting here (style guide section 7).

decisions.choice: "le juste … vivra" (L, B) as Romans 1:17, but "par sa fidélité", never "par la foi"
decisions.reason: Romans 1:17, Galatians 3:11 and Hebrews 10:38 quote the Greek, "by faith"; the Hebrew *emunah* is steady faithfulness. French keeps the published New Testament's "le juste vivra" so the quotation is seen, and translates the Hebrew noun as "fidélité". Readable says it as a way of living ("en restant fidèle"), as the English Readable.

decisions.choice: "el justo por su fidelidad vivirá" (L); "el justo vivirá por su fidelidad" (B); "la persona que hace lo correcto vivirá por ser fiel" (R)
alternatives: el justo por la fe vivirá
decisions.reason: The term sheet's wording. 'Emunah is "fidelidad", not the New Testament's "fe"; "el justo ... vivirá" is kept so that Romans 1:17, Galatians 3:11 and Hebrews 10:38 ("por la fe") can be seen. "Su" covers both sexes, so there is no gender span.

decisions.choice: "kwa uaminifu wake" (L, B); "kwa kuwa mwaminifu" (R)
decisions.reason: The Hebrew 'emunah is steady faithfulness, so "uaminifu" is used, not the New Testament key term "imani". "Mwenye haki ataishi" is worded as Romans 1:17, Galatians 3:11 and Hebrews 10:38, which quote the line from the Greek with "imani" (faith); the English allusion decision gives the link. "Wake" covers a man or a woman, so the Swahili needs no gender span where the English has one; recorded once for this job.

decisions.choice: "의인은 자기의 신실함으로 살 것이다" (L), "의로운 사람은 자기의 신실함으로 살 것이다" (B), "바르게 사는 사람은 신실함으로 살 것이다" (R); *'emunah* is "신실함", not "믿음"
decisions.reason: The term sheet's wording. "의인" and "의로운 사람 … 살 것이다" match the Korean Galatians 3:11 (L) and Romans 1:17 (B) so the quotation can be seen, but the Hebrew word is steady faithfulness, which the New Testament's Greek renders "faith". No gender span: "자기" already covers both.

decisions.choice: "puffed up" is "교만한 자" (L, B) and "교만한 원수" (R); *nefesh* here is "영혼" (L) and "속마음", "마음" (B, R)
decisions.reason: Drafted from the gloss and away from the familiar older wording; the inner self is the seat of desire here, which Korean says with "마음".

decisions.choice: "sự thành tín của mình" (L, B) / "giữ lòng trung tín" (R), not "đức tin"
decisions.reason: The terms note: 'emunah is "sự thành tín", as in the Psalms, not the Greek key term; Romans 1:17 in Vietnamese reads "Người công chính sẽ sống bởi đức tin", from the Greek (see the allusion decision). "mình" covers both men and women, so no gender span is needed.

decisions.choice: o justo ... viverá pela sua fidelidade (L, B); a pessoa que é justa viverá por ser fiel (R)
decisions.reason: As the English, the Hebrew 'emunah is steady loyalty, so Literal and Balanced say "fidelidade" and Readable "por ser fiel" (m2). Romans 1:17, Galatians 3:11 and Hebrews 10:38 quote the line from the Greek, and their Portuguese says "O justo viverá pela fé" (L), "Aquele que é justo viverá pela fé" (B), "A pessoa que é justa viverá pela fé" (R) (m3). Each level here keeps their words, "o justo", "a pessoa que é justa", "viverá", and differs only where the Hebrew does, so the reader can hear the link and see the difference.

decisions.choice: pela sua fidelidade, with no gender setting
decisions.reason: The English needs a setting to choose between "their" and "his". Portuguese "sua" agrees with "fidelidade" and does not say whose, so it already reads of anyone righteous, and there is no second wording to offer.

decisions.choice: "ጻድቅ ግን በታማኝነቱ በሕይወት ይኖራል" (L, B); "ጻድቅ የሆነ ሰው ግን ታማኝ በመሆኑ በሕይወት ይኖራል" (R)
decisions.reason: Romans 1:17, Galatians 3:11 and Hebrews 10:38 quote this line from the Greek (m3), and their Amharic reads "ጻድቅ … በእምነት በሕይወት ይኖራል" (Hebrews "ጻድቄ", my righteous one). The Amharic keeps their "ጻድቅ" and "በሕይወት ይኖራል", and Readable their "ጻድቅ የሆነ ሰው", but follows the Hebrew "his faithfulness" (m2, as the English r-en-1): "ታማኝነት" is the Amharic for *ʾemunah*, steady loyalty to God, and "-ቱ" is "his". "እምነት" (faith, belief) is the word of the Greek quotations and is not used here.

decisions.choice: "በታማኝነቱ" with no gender span
decisions.reason: The English offers "their" or "his". The Amharic generic "ጻድቅ" with the masculine suffix already covers any righteous person, man or woman, so the setting has nothing to change.

decisions.choice: "своєю вірністю" (L, B), "тим, що буде вірною" (R), not "вірою"
decisions.reason: The Hebrew word is faithfulness, and the English decision keeps it so; Romans 1:17 and Hebrews 10:38 quote the Greek, which Ukrainian renders "з віри" / "вірою" there. The reflexive "своєю" covers men and women without a gender span.

decisions.choice: धर्मी [जन] ... से जीवित रहेगा as Romans 1:17; अपनी विश्वासयोग्यता for emunah
decisions.reason: Romans 1:17, Galatians 3:11 and Hebrews 10:38 quote this line from the Greek, where the word is "faith" (विश्वास). Each level keeps the New Testament's Hindi for the words the Hebrew shares (L धर्मी [जन] ... जीवित रहेगा; B जो धर्मी है, वह ... जीवित रहेगा; R जो व्यक्ति धर्मी है, वह ... जीवित रहेगा). For the Hebrew emunah, steady loyalty and faithfulness (m2), it says अपनी विश्वासयोग्यता (L, B) and विश्वासयोग्य बने रहने से (R), the poetry note's word for faithfulness, not the New Testament's विश्वास. The English gives "his" a gender setting; Hindi अपनी has no gender, so there is no span.

decisions.choice: а праведный своей верностью будет жить (L); праведный будет жить своей верностью (B); человек, который праведен, будет жить, оставаясь верным (R)
alternatives: от веры будет жить; будет жить верой
decisions.reason: Romans 1:17, Galatians 3:11 and Hebrews 10:38 quote this line from the Greek, "the righteous will live by faith"; each level keeps their Russian for "праведный ... будет жить" (Romans and Galatians: "А праведный от веры будет жить" L, "Праведный будет жить верой" B, "Человек, который праведен, будет жить верой" R). Emunah here is the righteous person's own steady faithfulness, so Russian says "верностью", not "верой", as the meaning decision has it.

decisions.choice: своей верностью, with no gender span
decisions.reason: The English has a gender span on "their / his"; Russian says the reflexive "своей", which refers to any righteous person, man or woman, so no span is needed.

decisions.choice: be'emunato "その真実によって" (L), "その誠実によって" (B), "神に忠実であることによって" (R), not "信仰によって"; tsaddiq "正しい者" (L, B), "正しいことをする人" (R); yichyeh "生きる".
decisions.reason: 'emunah is steady faithfulness (m2, r-en-1). L keeps the OT key word "真実" (Lamentations 3:23, Hosea 2:22); B uses "誠実", as Isaiah 11:5 for a person's 'emunah, so the line is not read as "truth"; R says what it is. Romans 1:17, Galatians 3:11 and Hebrews 10:38 were checked: their Japanese "正しい者は信仰によって生きる" renders the Greek pistis, so "正しい者 ... によって生きる" is shared and only the key word differs, as the footnote (m3) explains.

decisions.choice: The English gender span on 'their / his faithfulness' has no Japanese span: "その" is not gendered.
decisions.reason: Japanese pronouns of this kind are already inclusive (style guide 7a).

source.text: וְאַף֙ כִּֽי־הַיַּ֣יִן בּוֹגֵ֔ד גֶּ֥בֶר יָהִ֖יר וְלֹ֣א יִנְוֶ֑ה אֲשֶׁר֩ הִרְחִ֨יב כִּשְׁא֜וֹל נַפְשׁ֗וֹ וְה֤וּא כַמָּ֨וֶת֙ וְלֹ֣א יִשְׂבָּ֔ע וַיֶּאֱסֹ֤ף אֵלָיו֙ כָּל־הַגּוֹיִ֔ם וַיִּקְבֹּ֥ץ אֵלָ֖יו כָּל־הָעַמִּֽים׃

records.literal_gloss: And moreover, the wine is treacherous; an arrogant man, and he will not stay at home, who has made wide like Sheol his throat, and he [is] like death and is not satisfied; and he has gathered to himself all the nations, and he has collected to himself all the peoples.

en.L: And moreover, the wine is treacherous; \q an arrogant man will not stay at rest, \q who makes his throat as wide as Sheol, and he [is] like death and is not satisfied; \q he gathers to himself all the nations \q and collects to himself all the peoples.
en.B: Moreover, wine betrays the arrogant man; \q he is never at rest. \q He opens his throat as wide as Sheol; like death, he is never satisfied. \q He gathers all the nations for himself \q and collects all the peoples as his own.
en.R: Wine deceives the proud man, \q and he never rests. \q His appetite is as big as the grave. Like death, he always wants more. \q He gathers all the nations for himself \q and takes all the peoples as his own.

fr.L: Et de plus, le vin est perfide ; \q l’homme arrogant ne restera pas en repos, \q lui qui élargit sa gorge comme le Shéol, et il [est] comme la mort et n’est pas rassasié ; \q il rassemble vers lui toutes les nations \q et réunit vers lui tous les peuples.
fr.B: De plus, le vin trahit l’homme arrogant ; \q il n’est jamais en repos. \q Il ouvre sa gorge aussi grande que le séjour des morts ; comme la mort, il n’est jamais rassasié. \q Il rassemble pour lui toutes les nations \q et réunit tous les peuples comme son bien.
fr.R: Le vin trompe l’homme orgueilleux, \q et il ne se repose jamais. \q Son appétit est aussi grand que le séjour des morts. Comme la mort, il en veut toujours plus. \q Il rassemble toutes les nations pour lui-même \q et prend tous les peuples comme s’ils lui appartenaient.

es.L: Y además, el vino es traicionero; \q el hombre arrogante no se quedará quieto, \q que ensancha como el Seol su garganta, y él [es] como la muerte y no se sacia; \q reúne para sí a todas las naciones \q y recoge para sí a todos los pueblos.
es.B: Además, el vino traiciona al hombre arrogante; \q nunca está tranquilo. \q Abre su garganta tan ancha como el lugar de los muertos; como la muerte, nunca se sacia. \q Reúne para sí a todas las naciones \q y se apropia de todos los pueblos.
es.R: El vino engaña al hombre orgulloso, \q y nunca descansa. \q Su apetito es tan grande como el sepulcro. Como la muerte, siempre quiere más. \q Reúne para sí a todas las naciones \q y se queda con todos los pueblos.

sw.L: Na zaidi ya hayo, divai ni danganyifu; \q mtu mwenye kiburi hatatulia, \q anayepanua koo lake kama Kuzimu, naye [ni] kama mauti, wala hashibi; \q anajikusanyia mataifa yote \q na kujikusanyia watu wote.
sw.B: Tena, divai inamsaliti mtu mwenye kiburi; \q hatulii kamwe. \q Anapanua koo lake kama Kuzimu; kama mauti, hashibi kamwe. \q Anajikusanyia mataifa yote \q na kuwakusanya watu wote wawe wake.
sw.R: Divai inamdanganya mtu mwenye kiburi, \q naye hatulii kamwe. \q Tamaa yake ni kubwa kama kaburi. Kama kifo, kila mara anataka zaidi. \q Anajikusanyia mataifa yote \q na kuwachukua watu wote wawe wake.

vi.L: Hơn nữa, rượu thật phản trắc; \q kẻ kiêu căng sẽ không ở yên, \q kẻ mở rộng cổ họng mình như Âm Phủ, và hắn [như] sự chết, không hề no; \q hắn gom về cho mình mọi nước \q và thu nhóm cho mình mọi dân.
vi.B: Hơn nữa, rượu phản bội kẻ kiêu căng; \q hắn chẳng bao giờ yên. \q Hắn há cổ họng rộng như Âm Phủ; như sự chết, hắn không bao giờ thỏa mãn. \q Hắn gom hết các nước về cho mình \q và thu nhóm mọi dân làm của riêng.
vi.R: Rượu lừa gạt kẻ kiêu ngạo, \q và hắn không bao giờ chịu yên. \q Lòng tham của hắn lớn như nơi của người chết. Như sự chết, hắn luôn muốn thêm nữa. \q Hắn gom hết các nước về cho mình \q và chiếm hết các dân làm của riêng.

ko.L: 게다가 포도주는 배신하는 것이다. \q 교만한 사람은 가만히 있지 못한다. \q 그는 스올처럼 자기 목구멍을 넓히고, 죽음과 같아서 만족하지 않는다. \q 그는 모든 민족을 자기에게로 모으고, \q 모든 백성을 자기에게로 거두어들인다.
ko.B: 게다가 포도주는 교만한 사람을 속인다. \q 그는 한시도 가만히 있지 못한다. \q 그는 스올처럼 목구멍을 크게 벌리고, 죽음처럼 결코 만족하지 않는다. \q 그는 모든 민족을 자기 것으로 모아들이고, \q 모든 백성을 자기 것으로 거두어들인다.
ko.R: 포도주는 교만한 사람을 속인다. \q 그는 결코 쉬지 못한다. \q 그의 욕심은 죽은 사람들이 있는 곳처럼 끝이 없다. 죽음처럼 언제나 더 많이 가지려고 한다. \q 그는 모든 민족을 자기 것으로 모으고, \q 모든 백성을 자기 것으로 삼는다.

pt.L: E, além disso, o vinho é traiçoeiro; \q o homem arrogante não ficará em repouso, \q ele, que alarga a sua garganta como o Sheol, e [é] como a morte e não se sacia; \q ele ajunta para si todas as nações \q e reúne para si todos os povos.
pt.B: Além disso, o vinho trai o homem arrogante; \q ele nunca descansa. \q Abre a garganta tanto quanto o mundo dos mortos; como a morte, nunca se satisfaz. \q Ajunta para si todas as nações \q e reúne todos os povos como seus.
pt.R: O vinho engana o homem orgulhoso, \q e ele nunca descansa. \q O seu apetite é tão grande quanto o mundo dos mortos. Como a morte, ele sempre quer mais. \q Ele junta todas as nações para si \q e toma todos os povos como seus.

am.L: ደግሞም የወይን ጠጅ ከዳተኛ ነው፤ \q ትዕቢተኛ ሰው አያርፍም፤ \q ጉሮሮውን እንደ ሲኦል የሚያሰፋ፤ እርሱም እንደ ሞት [ነው]፤ አይጠግብምም፤ \q ሕዝቦችን ሁሉ ለራሱ ይሰበስባል፤ \q ወገኖችንም ሁሉ ለራሱ ያከማቻል።
am.B: ደግሞም የወይን ጠጅ ትዕቢተኛውን ሰው ይከዳዋል፤ \q እርሱ ከቶ አያርፍም። \q ጉሮሮውን እንደ ሙታን ዓለም ይከፍታል፤ እንደ ሞትም ከቶ አይጠግብም። \q ሕዝቦችን ሁሉ ለራሱ ይሰበስባል፤ \q ወገኖችንም ሁሉ የራሱ አድርጎ ያከማቻል።
am.R: የወይን ጠጅ ትዕቢተኛውን ሰው ያታልለዋል፤ \q እርሱም ከቶ አያርፍም። \q ምኞቱ እንደ መቃብር ሰፊ ነው፤ እንደ ሞትም ሁልጊዜ ተጨማሪ ይፈልጋል። \q ሕዝቦችን ሁሉ ለራሱ ይሰበስባል፤ \q ወገኖችንም ሁሉ የራሱ ያደርጋል።

hi.L: और फिर, दाखमधु विश्वासघाती है; \q अहंकारी पुरुष चैन से नहीं रहता, \q जो अपना गला शिओल के समान चौड़ा करता है, और वह मृत्यु के समान [है] और तृप्त नहीं होता; \q वह सब जातियों को अपने पास इकट्ठा करता है \q और सब लोगों को अपने लिए बटोर लेता है।
hi.B: इसके अलावा, दाखमधु अहंकारी पुरुष को धोखा देता है; \q वह कभी चैन से नहीं रहता। \q वह अपना गला अधोलोक के समान चौड़ा खोलता है; मृत्यु के समान वह कभी तृप्त नहीं होता। \q वह सब राष्ट्रों को अपने लिए इकट्ठा करता है \q और सब लोगों को अपना बना लेता है।
hi.R: दाखमधु घमंडी पुरुष को धोखा देता है, \q और वह कभी चैन से नहीं रहता। \q उसकी भूख मृत्यु के लोक के समान बड़ी है। मृत्यु की तरह वह और-और चाहता है। \q वह सब देशों को अपने लिए इकट्ठा करता है \q और सब लोगों को अपना बना लेता है।

ru.L: И к тому же вино коварно; \q надменный человек не будет пребывать в покое, \q который расширяет, как шеол, свою глотку, и он — как смерть, и не насыщается; \q и собирает он к себе все народы \q и забирает себе все племена.
ru.B: К тому же вино предаёт надменного человека, \q и он не знает покоя. \q Он разевает свою глотку, как мир мёртвых; как смерть, он ненасытен. \q Он собирает себе все народы \q и присваивает себе все племена.
ru.R: Вино обманывает гордого человека, \q и он никогда не успокаивается. \q Его жадность так же велика, как мир мёртвых. Как смерть, он всегда хочет больше. \q Он собирает себе все народы \q и забирает себе все племена.

ja.L: しかも、ぶどう酒は裏切る。 \q 高ぶる者は落ち着いていない。 \q 彼は陰府のようにその喉を広げ、死のように満ち足りることがない。 \q 彼はすべての国々を自分のもとに集め、 \q すべての民を自分のもとに寄せ集める。
ja.B: さらに、ぶどう酒は高ぶる者を裏切る。 \q 彼は決して休むことがない。 \q 陰府のようにその喉を大きく開き、死のように決して満ち足りない。 \q 彼はすべての国々を自分のために集め、 \q すべての民を自分のものとして寄せ集める。
ja.R: ぶどう酒は、高ぶる者をだます。 \q 彼は決して休まない。 \q 彼の欲は、死者の世界のように大きい。死のように、いつももっと欲しがる。 \q 彼はすべての国々を自分のために集め、 \q すべての民を自分のものにする。

uk.L: І до того ж вино зрадливе; \q гордий чоловік не спочине, \q той, хто розширює, як шеол, свою горлянку, і він як смерть, і не насититься; \q він збирає до себе всі народи \q і скупчує до себе всі племена.
uk.B: До того ж вино зраджує гордого чоловіка; \q він ніколи не має спокою. \q Він роззявляє свою горлянку широко, як світ мертвих; як смерть, він ніколи не насититься. \q Він збирає собі всі народи \q і скупчує всі племена як свої.
uk.R: Вино обманює гордого чоловіка, \q і він ніколи не має спокою. \q Його жадібність велика, як могила. Як смерть, він завжди хоче більше. \q Він збирає собі всі народи \q і забирає всі племена як свої.

decisions.choice: the wine is treacherous
decisions.reason: The Hebrew reads "the wine". Wine makes the proud man reckless and false; the Babylonians were known for their feasting (Daniel 5). The commentary on Habakkuk among the Dead Sea Scrolls reads "wealth", a word that looks much like it, and some prefer that reading. The translation keeps the Hebrew.

decisions.choice: he will not stay at rest
decisions.reason: The verb is rare. It may mean to stay at home, to rest, or to reach one's goal: the arrogant man is never content and always on the move for more conquest.

decisions.choice: his throat as wide as Sheol, like death never satisfied: endless greed
decisions.reason: Sheol, the place of the dead, and death itself are pictured as a mouth that swallows everyone and is never full (Isaiah 5:14; Proverbs 27:20; 30:15-16). The Babylonian swallows nation after nation.

decisions.choice: the grave (R)
decisions.reason: As in Isaiah, Readable says "the grave" for Sheol, and "appetite" for "throat".

decisions.choice: "el Seol" (L); "el lugar de los muertos" (B); "el sepulcro" (R)
decisions.reason: Sheol follows the Spanish of the Psalms and Isaiah: kept at L, explained at B. R says "sepulcro", as the English R says "the grave".

decisions.choice: "Kuzimu" (L, B); "kaburi" (R)
decisions.reason: Sheol is "Kuzimu", as in the Psalms and Isaiah; Readable says "the grave" with the English Readable.

decisions.choice: "Âm Phủ" (L, B) / "nơi của người chết" (R) for Sheol
decisions.reason: The Isaiah terms note's wording for Sheol.

decisions.choice: o Sheol (L); o mundo dos mortos (B, R)
decisions.reason: For the whole book, as the Old Testament terms and Isaiah 5:14 set it: "o Sheol" at Literal and "o mundo dos mortos" at Balanced and Readable, where the English Readable says "the grave" (m3).

decisions.choice: Sheol "ሲኦል" (L), "ሙታን ዓለም" (B), "መቃብር" (R); the nations … the peoples "ሕዝቦች … ወገኖች"
decisions.reason: Sheol follows the terms list ("ሲኦል" at Literal; the world of the dead at Balanced, since "ሲኦል" now reads as hell), and Readable says "the grave", as the English Readable. Where *goyim* and *ʿammim* stand in parallel lines, they are "ሕዝቦች" and "ወገኖች", as the Psalms list and Jeremiah 51:58.

decisions.choice: शिओल (L); अधोलोक (B); मृत्यु का लोक (R)
decisions.reason: Sheol takes the forms set for the poetry and the Prophets at each level.

decisions.choice: шеол (L); мир мёртвых (B, R)
decisions.reason: Sheol takes the forms set in the Psalms.

decisions.choice: hayyayin boged "ぶどう酒は裏切る" (L, B), "だます" (R); She'ol "陰府" (L, B), "死者の世界" (R) although the English R says grave.
decisions.reason: The OT convention for Sheol (JOB, PSA, ISA-ISA-1); the uncertain text of 'wine' (m1) is followed as chosen.

source.text: הֲלוֹא־אֵ֣לֶּה כֻלָּ֗ם עָלָיו֙ מָשָׁ֣ל יִשָּׂ֔אוּ וּמְלִיצָ֖ה חִיד֣וֹת ל֑וֹ וְיֹאמַ֗ר ה֚וֹי הַמַּרְבֶּ֣ה לֹּא־ל֔וֹ עַד־מָתַ֕י וּמַכְבִּ֥יד עָלָ֖יו עַבְטִֽיט׃

records.literal_gloss: Will not these all of them against him take up a taunt, and a mocking poem, riddles about him, and say: Woe [to the one who] increases what [is] not his! Until when? And [who] makes heavy on himself pledges!

en.L: Will not all of these take up a taunt against him, \q a mocking poem and riddles about him, and say: \q Woe, [the one who] multiplies what is not his own! How long? \q And [who] loads himself with pledges!
en.B: Will not all of them take up a mocking song against him, \q with scorn and riddles about him, and say: \q Woe to him who piles up what is not his own! How long will this go on? \q He weighs himself down with goods taken in pledge!
en.R: All the nations he has conquered will sing songs to make fun of him. \q They will mock him with riddles and say: \q How terrible it will be for the one who takes what does not belong to him! How long can this last? \q He grows rich on what he takes from people who owe him.

fr.L: Ceux-ci, tous, ne lanceront-ils pas contre lui une satire, \q un poème moqueur, des énigmes sur lui, et ne diront-ils pas : \q Malheur, [celui qui] accumule ce qui n’est pas à lui ! Jusqu’à quand ? \q Et [qui] se charge de gages !
fr.B: Tous ne chanteront-ils pas contre lui un chant moqueur, \q avec des railleries et des énigmes sur lui ? Ils diront : \q Malheur à celui qui entasse ce qui ne lui appartient pas ! Jusqu’à quand cela durera-t-il ? \q Il se charge de biens pris en gage !
fr.R: Toutes les nations qu’il a conquises chanteront des chansons pour se moquer de lui. \q Elles se moqueront de lui avec des énigmes et diront : \q Quel malheur pour celui qui prend ce qui n’est pas à lui ! Combien de temps cela peut-il durer ? \q Il s’enrichit avec ce qu’il prend à ceux qui lui doivent de l’argent.

es.L: ¿No alzarán todos estos contra él un refrán de burla, \q un poema satírico y enigmas acerca de él? Dirán: \q ¡Ay del que multiplica lo que no es suyo! ¿Hasta cuándo? \q ¡Y [del que] se carga de prendas!
es.B: ¿No le cantarán todos ellos una canción de burla, \q con escarnio y enigmas acerca de él? Dirán: \q ¡Ay del que amontona lo que no es suyo! ¿Hasta cuándo va a durar esto? \q ¡Se carga de bienes tomados en prenda!
es.R: Todas las naciones que conquistó cantarán canciones para burlarse de él. \q Se burlarán de él con enigmas y dirán: \q ¡Qué terrible será para el que se queda con lo que no le pertenece! ¿Cuánto tiempo puede durar esto? \q Se hace rico con lo que les quita a los que le deben.

sw.L: Je, hawa wote hawatatunga mithali ya dhihaka dhidi yake, \q shairi la kumcheka na mafumbo juu yake, na kusema: \q Ole, [yeye] anayeongeza kisicho chake! Hadi lini? \q Na [anayejitwika] mzigo wa rehani!
sw.B: Je, wote hawa hawatamtungia wimbo wa dhihaka, \q wakimdharau kwa mafumbo, na kusema: \q Ole wake yeye anayelundika kisicho chake! Hadi lini? \q Anajilemea kwa mali aliyotwaa kama rehani!
sw.R: Mataifa yote aliyoyashinda yatamtungia nyimbo za kumdhihaki. \q Watamcheka kwa mafumbo na kusema: \q Itakuwa vibaya sana kwa yule anayechukua kisicho chake! Hili litaendelea hadi lini? \q Anatajirika kwa mali anayowanyang'anya watu wanaomdai.

vi.L: Chẳng phải tất cả những dân này sẽ đặt lời châm biếm nghịch cùng hắn, \q một bài thơ chế nhạo và những câu đố về hắn, mà nói: \q Khốn cho [kẻ] làm tăng thêm những gì không phải của mình! Cho đến bao giờ? \q Và [kẻ] chất trên mình những của cầm!
vi.B: Chẳng phải tất cả các dân ấy sẽ đặt bài ca chế giễu hắn, \q với lời khinh bỉ và những câu đố về hắn, mà nói: \q Khốn cho kẻ chất đống những gì không thuộc về mình! Còn đến bao giờ nữa? \q Hắn tự đè nặng mình bằng những món đồ cầm cố!
vi.R: Mọi dân hắn đã chinh phục sẽ hát những bài ca chế nhạo hắn. \q Họ sẽ chế giễu hắn bằng những câu đố mà nói: \q Thật khốn khổ cho kẻ lấy những gì không thuộc về mình! Điều này còn kéo dài được bao lâu? \q Hắn làm giàu bằng của cải lấy từ những người mắc nợ hắn.

ko.L: 이 모든 자들이 그를 두고 조롱하는 노래를, \q 비웃는 시와 그에 대한 수수께끼를 읊으며 말하지 않겠느냐? \q 화가 있다, 자기 것이 아닌 것을 늘리는 자에게! 언제까지냐? \q 담보물로 자기를 무겁게 하는 자에게!
ko.B: 그들이 모두 그를 두고 조롱하는 노래를 부르고, \q 비웃으며 그에 대한 수수께끼를 말하지 않겠느냐? \q 자기 것이 아닌 것을 쌓아 올리는 자에게 화가 있다! 언제까지 이렇게 하겠느냐? \q 그는 담보로 빼앗은 물건들로 자기 몸을 무겁게 한다!
ko.R: 그가 정복한 모든 민족이 그를 놀리는 노래를 부를 것이다. \q 그들은 수수께끼로 그를 비웃으며 말할 것이다. \q 남의 것을 빼앗는 자에게 끔찍한 일이 닥칠 것이다! 이런 일이 언제까지 가겠느냐? \q 그는 빚진 사람들에게서 빼앗은 것으로 부자가 되었다.

pt.L: Não levantarão todos estes uma sátira contra ele, \q uma canção de zombaria e enigmas a respeito dele, e dirão: \q Ai daquele que multiplica o que não é seu! Até quando? \q E [daquele que] se carrega de penhores!
pt.B: Não entoarão todos eles uma canção de zombaria contra ele, \q com desprezo e enigmas a seu respeito, dizendo: \q Ai daquele que amontoa o que não é seu! Até quando isso vai continuar? \q Ele se sobrecarrega de bens tomados como penhor!
pt.R: Todas as nações que ele conquistou vão cantar canções para zombar dele. \q Vão caçoar dele com enigmas e dizer: \q Que desgraça vai cair sobre aquele que toma o que não lhe pertence! Até quando isso vai durar? \q Ele fica rico com o que toma das pessoas que lhe devem.

am.L: እነዚህ ሁሉ በእርሱ ላይ የመሣለቂያ ምሳሌ አያነሡምን? \q የፌዝ ቅኔንና እንቆቅልሽን ስለ እርሱ [አያነሡምን]? እንዲህም አይሉምን፦ \q ወዮ የእርሱ ያልሆነውን ለሚያበዛ! እስከ መቼ? \q በራሱም ላይ መያዣን ለሚያከብድ!
am.B: እነዚህ ሁሉ በእርሱ ላይ የፌዝ ዘፈን በማንሣት፣ \q በንቀትና በእንቆቅልሽ ስለ እርሱ እንዲህ አይሉምን፦ \q የእርሱ ያልሆነውን ለሚያከማች ወዮለት! ይህ እስከ መቼ ይቀጥላል? \q በመያዣ በተወሰደ ዕቃ ራሱን ያከብዳል!
am.R: ድል ያደረጋቸው ሕዝቦች ሁሉ እርሱን ለማሾፍ ዘፈን ይዘፍናሉ። \q በእንቆቅልሽ እያፌዙበት እንዲህ ይላሉ፦ \q የእርሱ ያልሆነውን ለሚወስድ ወዮለት! ይህ እስከ መቼ ይዘልቃል? \q ዕዳ ካለባቸው ሰዎች በሚወስደው ነገር ይበለጽጋል።

hi.L: क्या ये सब उसके विरुद्ध ताना देनेवाला गीत, \q व्यंग्य की कविता और उसके विषय में पहेलियाँ न कहेंगे, और न कहेंगे: \q हाय, [उस पर] जो वह बढ़ाता है जो उसका नहीं है! कब तक? \q और [जो] अपने ऊपर गिरवी का बोझ लादता है!
hi.B: क्या वे सब उसके विरुद्ध ठट्ठे का गीत नहीं गाएँगे, \q उसकी हँसी उड़ाते और पहेलियाँ कहते हुए, और न कहेंगे: \q हाय उस पर जो वह बटोरता जाता है जो उसका अपना नहीं है! यह कब तक चलेगा? \q वह गिरवी के माल से अपने को लादता जाता है!
hi.R: जिन देशों को उसने जीता, वे सब उसकी हँसी उड़ाने के लिए गीत गाएँगे। \q वे पहेलियों से उसका मज़ाक़ उड़ाएँगे और कहेंगे: \q उसका कितना बुरा हाल होगा जो वह लेता है जो उसका नहीं है! यह कब तक चलेगा? \q वह उनसे लिए गए माल से धनी होता जाता है जो उसके क़र्ज़दार हैं।

ru.L: Не поднимут ли все они о нём насмешливую песнь, \q язвительную притчу и загадки о нём, и не скажут ли: \q Горе умножающему не своё! Доколе? \q И отягощающему себя залогами!
ru.B: Разве не сложат все они о нём насмешливую песнь, \q с издёвками и загадками о нём, и не скажут: \q Горе тому, кто копит чужое! Доколе это будет? \q Он отягощает себя взятым в залог!
ru.R: Все народы, которые он завоевал, будут петь о нём насмешливые песни. \q Они будут смеяться над ним загадками и скажут: \q Беда ждёт того, кто берёт то, что ему не принадлежит! Сколько это может продолжаться? \q Он богатеет на том, что отбирает у своих должников.

ja.L: これらの者は皆、彼に向かってあざけりの歌を唱え、 \q 皮肉の詩と謎の言葉を彼に向けて、こう言うではないか。 \q ああ、災いだ、自分のものでないものを増し加える者は！いつまでか。 \q 質物で自分を重くする者は！
ja.B: 彼らは皆、彼に対してあざけりの歌を歌い、 \q 嘲笑と謎の言葉で彼をからかって、こう言うではないか。 \q ああ、災いだ、自分のものでないものを積み上げる者は！いつまでこれが続くのか？ \q 彼は、質に取った物で自分を重くしている！
ja.R: 彼に征服された国々は皆、彼をばかにする歌を歌う。 \q 謎の言葉で彼をあざけって、こう言う。 \q ああ、自分のものでないものを奪い取る者は、なんとひどい目にあうことか！こんなことが、いつまで続くのか？ \q 彼は、借金のある人々から取り立てた物で、金持ちになっている。

uk.L: Хіба всі ці не складуть про нього глузливу пісню, \q насмішливу приповідку й загадки про нього, і не скажуть: \q Горе [тому, хто] намножує не своє! Доки? \q І [хто] обтяжує себе заставами!
uk.B: Хіба всі вони не складуть про нього глузливу пісню, \q з насмішками й загадками про нього, і не скажуть: \q Горе тому, хто громадить не своє! Доки це триватиме? \q Він обтяжує себе добром, узятим у заставу!
uk.R: Усі народи, які він підкорив, співатимуть пісні, щоб насміятися з нього. \q Вони глузуватимуть з нього загадками й казатимуть: \q Горе тому, хто бере те, що йому не належить! Доки це може тривати? \q Він багатіє з того, що забирає в боржників.

decisions.choice: a taunt, a mocking poem, riddles
decisions.reason: The words are forms of wise sayings and poems turned to mockery. Isaiah 14:4 uses the first word for the taunt over the king of Babylon. The nations he has swallowed will sing his downfall.

decisions.choice: Woe: the first of five woes
decisions.reason: The taunt is made of five sayings that begin with "Woe" (verses 6, 9, 12, 15 and 19), each followed by its reason and its punishment. "Woe" is the cry of mourning over the dead, raised over one who is doomed (Nahum 3:1). The five woes are both the nations' taunt and the LORD's word, as verses 13 and 16 show, and no one marks where the taunt ends.

decisions.choice: loads himself with pledges: wealth taken by force, like a ruthless creditor
decisions.reason: A pledge was an item a borrower gave as security for a loan; the law limited what could be taken and required that some things be returned (Deuteronomy 24:6, 10-13). Babylon is pictured as a creditor who has seized the goods of the nations, piling up wealth that is not its own. Verse 7 turns the picture around.

decisions.choice: Woe (L); Woe to (B); How terrible it will be for (R); no quotation marks
decisions.reason: The settled wording for this cry (Isaiah 5:8). The taunt runs through the five woes without a marked end and is also the LORD's own word (m2), so no quotation marks are used; a colon after "say" introduces it.

decisions.choice: goods taken in pledge (B); what he takes from people who owe him (R)
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable explain the pledges (m3). Readable names the nations as those who sing.

decisions.choice: *hoy* "Malheur, [celui qui] …" (L), "Malheur à celui qui …" (B), "Quel malheur pour celui qui … !" (R), in all five woes (2:6, 9, 12, 15, 19), with no quotation marks
decisions.reason: The prophets' French formula for *hoy*, as Isaiah 5:8-22; the taunt song is set as poetry, without quotation marks, as the English.

decisions.choice: "¡Ay del que ...!" (L, B); "¡Qué terrible será para ...!" (R); no quotation marks
decisions.reason: Hoy follows the Spanish prophets in all five woes of this chapter (2:6, 9, 12, 15, 19). The taunt song is part of the oracle and takes no quotation marks, as in the English.

decisions.choice: "Ole, [yeye] ..." (L); "Ole wake ..." (B); "Itakuwa vibaya sana kwa ..." (R)
decisions.reason: Hoy follows the Isaiah block ("Ole", "Ole wao", "Itakuwa vibaya sana kwa"), here in the singular because the five woes speak of one oppressor. The woes are part of the taunt and take no quotation marks, as in the English. One wording for all five woes.

decisions.choice: *hoy* is "…에게 화가 있다" (L, B) and "…에게 끔찍한 일이 닥칠 것이다" (R) in all five woes (2:6, 9, 12, 15, 19); no quotation marks around the taunt
decisions.reason: The term sheet's wording for *hoy*, as Isaiah 5 (Literal opens with "화가 있다," as Isaiah 5:8 L does). The taunt is poetry inside the oracle, so like the English it takes no quotation marks.

decisions.choice: "Khốn cho" (L, B) / "Thật khốn khổ cho" (R) for hoy, here and in the four woes that follow (verses 9, 12, 15, 19)
decisions.reason: The Isaiah terms note's wording for hoy as a threat, as Matthew 23:13. The taunt song has no quotation marks, as the English.

decisions.choice: uma sátira (L); uma canção de zombaria (B, R); Ai daquele que (L, B); Que desgraça vai cair sobre aquele que (R), in all five woes (verses 6, 9, 12, 15, 19)
decisions.reason: For the whole chapter: the taunt takes the words of Isaiah 14:4 in Portuguese, "sátira" at Literal and "canção de zombaria" at Balanced, and the cry hoy the wording Isaiah set ("Ai de", Readable "Que desgraça vai cair sobre"), with "daquele que" for the singular participles (m2). As in the English, no quotation marks enclose the taunt, which runs through the five woes without a marked end.

decisions.choice: Woe formula: L "ወዮ … ለሚ…!" with the woe first, as the Hebrew and Isaiah 5:8, 20 (Literal); B, R "… ለሚ… ወዮለት!" at the end of the clause, as Isaiah 5 and Jeremiah 22:13 (Balanced, Readable)
decisions.reason: The five woes (2:6, 9, 12, 15, 19) keep one wording. Amharic "ወዮለት" is the living word for this cry of doom, and its Readable sense is what the English Readable "How terrible it will be for" spells out, so Readable keeps it, as Isaiah's and Jeremiah's Readable do. As in the English, the taunt song has no quotation marks.

decisions.choice: हाय, [उस पर] जो (L); हाय उस पर जो (B); उसका कितना बुरा हाल होगा जो (R)
decisions.reason: The five woes (verses 6, 9, 12, 15, 19) take the wording set for the Prophets, in the singular. Hoy against others takes one Readable form through the Prophets, the wording Luke 11:42-52 uses in this translation (तुम्हारा कितना बुरा हाल होगा), as Isaiah 10:1, Jeremiah 22:13 and Zechariah 11:17. As in the English, the taunt has no quotation marks: it runs through the woes and is also the LORD's own word.

decisions.choice: Горе (L, B); Беда ждёт того, кто (R); no quotation marks
decisions.reason: "Woe" takes the forms set for the Prophets in the first of Habakkuk's five woes (verses 6, 9, 12, 15, 19). As in the English, the taunt has no quotation marks, since it is also the LORD's own word.

decisions.choice: The woe formula is the same in all five woes (2:6, 2:9, 2:12, 2:15, 2:19): "ああ、災いだ、……者は！" (L, B), "ああ、……者は、なんとひどい目にあうことか！" (R), the singular of Isaiah's hoy-sayings (Isaiah 5:8, 45:9); no quotation marks, as the English.
decisions.reason: One fixed form lets the reader hear the five woes as one series (ISA-ISA-1 hoy formula).

decisions.choice: mashal "あざけりの歌" (as Micah 2:4); melitsah "皮肉の詩" (L), "嘲笑" (B); chidot "謎の言葉"; 'avtit "質物" (L), "質に取った物" (B), R by the English R.
decisions.reason: The three words for the taunt are kept apart at L (m1).

source.text: הֲל֣וֹא פֶ֗תַע יָק֨וּמוּ֙ נֹשְׁכֶ֔יךָ וְיִקְצ֖וּ מְזַעְזְעֶ֑יךָ וְהָיִ֥יתָ לִמְשִׁסּ֖וֹת לָֽמוֹ׃

records.literal_gloss: Will not suddenly arise those who bite you, and wake up those who make you tremble? And you will become plunder for them.

en.L: Will not those who bite you arise suddenly, \q and those who make you tremble wake up? \q And you will become plunder for them.
en.B: Will not your creditors rise up suddenly, \q and those who make you tremble wake up? \q Then you will become their plunder.
en.R: Suddenly the people you owe will come to collect, \q and they will wake up and make you tremble. \q Then they will rob you of everything.

fr.L: Ceux qui te mordent ne se lèveront-ils pas soudain, \q et ceux qui te font trembler ne se réveilleront-ils pas ? \q Et tu deviendras pour eux un butin.
fr.B: Tes créanciers ne se lèveront-ils pas soudain, \q et ceux qui te font trembler ne se réveilleront-ils pas ? \q Alors tu deviendras leur butin.
fr.R: Tout à coup, ceux à qui tu dois de l’argent viendront réclamer leur dû. \q Ils se réveilleront et te feront trembler. \q Alors ils te prendront tout ce que tu as.

es.L: ¿No se levantarán de repente los que te muerden, \q y despertarán los que te hacen temblar? \q Y serás para ellos un botín.
es.B: ¿No se levantarán de repente tus acreedores, \q y despertarán los que te hacen temblar? \q Entonces serás su botín.
es.R: De repente vendrán a cobrar los que te prestaron, \q y despertarán y te harán temblar. \q Entonces te robarán todo.

sw.L: Je, wale wanaokuuma hawatainuka ghafla, \q na wale wanaokutetemesha hawataamka? \q Nawe utakuwa mateka kwao.
sw.B: Je, wanaokudai hawatainuka ghafla, \q na wale wanaokutetemesha hawataamka? \q Ndipo utakuwa nyara yao.
sw.R: Ghafla wale unaowadai watakuja kudai mali yao, \q nao wataamka na kukufanya utetemeke. \q Kisha watakunyang'anya kila kitu.

vi.L: Chẳng phải những kẻ cắn ngươi sẽ thình lình trỗi dậy, \q và những kẻ làm ngươi run sợ sẽ thức dậy sao? \q Rồi ngươi sẽ trở thành của cướp cho chúng.
vi.B: Chẳng phải các chủ nợ của ngươi sẽ thình lình nổi lên, \q và những kẻ làm ngươi run sợ sẽ thức dậy sao? \q Bấy giờ ngươi sẽ thành của cướp cho chúng.
vi.R: Thình lình những người ngươi mắc nợ sẽ đến đòi, \q họ sẽ thức dậy và làm cho ngươi run sợ. \q Rồi họ sẽ cướp sạch mọi thứ của ngươi.

ko.L: 너를 무는 자들이 갑자기 일어나지 않겠느냐? \q 너를 떨게 하는 자들이 깨어나지 않겠느냐? \q 그리고 너는 그들의 약탈물이 될 것이다.
ko.B: 너에게 빚을 받을 자들이 갑자기 일어나지 않겠느냐? \q 너를 떨게 할 자들이 깨어나지 않겠느냐? \q 그때 너는 그들에게 약탈을 당할 것이다.
ko.R: 갑자기 네가 빚진 사람들이 빚을 받으러 올 것이다. \q 그들이 깨어나 너를 떨게 할 것이다. \q 그들이 너에게서 모든 것을 빼앗아 갈 것이다.

pt.L: Não se levantarão de repente os que te mordem, \q e não despertarão os que te fazem tremer? \q E tu te tornarás presa para eles.
pt.B: Não se levantarão de repente os teus credores, \q e não despertarão os que te fazem tremer? \q Então te tornarás o despojo deles.
pt.R: De repente, as pessoas a quem deves vão vir cobrar, \q e vão acordar e te fazer tremer. \q Então elas vão roubar tudo o que tens.

am.L: ነካሾችህ ድንገት አይነሡምን? \q የሚያንቀጠቅጡህስ አይነቁምን? \q ለእነርሱም ምርኮ ትሆናለህ።
am.B: አበዳሪዎችህ ድንገት አይነሡብህምን? \q የሚያንቀጠቅጡህስ አይነቁምን? \q ያን ጊዜ ምርኮ ትሆናቸዋለህ።
am.R: ያበደሩህ ሰዎች ዕዳቸውን ለመሰብሰብ በድንገት ይመጣሉ፤ \q ይነሣሉ፤ ያንቀጠቅጡሃልም። \q ከዚያም ያለህን ሁሉ ይዘርፉሃል።

hi.L: क्या तुम्हें काटनेवाले अचानक न उठ खड़े होंगे, \q और तुम्हें कँपानेवाले न जागेंगे? \q और तुम उनके लिए लूट बन जाओगे।
hi.B: क्या तुम्हारे साहूकार अचानक न उठ खड़े होंगे, \q और तुम्हें कँपानेवाले न जाग उठेंगे? \q तब तुम उनकी लूट बन जाओगे।
hi.R: अचानक वे लोग वसूली करने आएँगे जिनके तुम क़र्ज़दार हो, \q और वे जागकर तुम्हें कँपा देंगे। \q तब वे तुम्हारा सब कुछ लूट लेंगे।

ru.L: Не встанут ли внезапно кусающие тебя, \q и не пробудятся ли заставляющие тебя трепетать? \q И ты станешь добычей для них.
ru.B: Разве не поднимутся внезапно твои заимодавцы \q и не проснутся те, кто заставит тебя дрожать? \q Тогда ты станешь их добычей.
ru.R: Вдруг придут те, кому ты должен, чтобы взыскать долг, \q и они проснутся и заставят тебя дрожать. \q Тогда они отнимут у тебя всё.

ja.L: おまえにかみつく者たちが、突然立ち上がり、 \q おまえを震え上がらせる者たちが、目を覚ますのではないか？ \q そして、おまえは彼らの略奪品となる。
ja.B: おまえに貸した者たちが、突然立ち上がり、 \q おまえを震え上がらせる者たちが目を覚ますのではないか？ \q そのとき、おまえは彼らの略奪品となる。
ja.R: 突然、おまえが借りのある人々が取り立てにやって来る。 \q 彼らは目を覚まし、おまえを震え上がらせる。 \q そして、おまえはすべてを奪い取られる。

uk.L: Хіба не повстануть раптом ті, хто кусає тебе, \q і не прокинуться ті, хто змушує тебе тремтіти? \q І ти станеш для них здобиччю.
uk.B: Хіба не повстануть раптом твої позикодавці \q і не прокинуться ті, хто змусить тебе тремтіти? \q Тоді ти станеш їхньою здобиччю.
uk.R: Раптом ті, кому ти винен, прийдуть по борг, \q прокинуться й змусять тебе тремтіти. \q Тоді вони заберуть у тебе все.

decisions.choice: those who bite you: your creditors
decisions.reason: The word means "those who bite" and also "those who lend at interest" (the verb is used of charging interest in Deuteronomy 23:20). The play on words turns the picture of verse 6 round: the ruthless creditor will find that he has creditors of his own, who will bite.

decisions.choice: you: the taunt now speaks to him
decisions.reason: The saying moves from "him" to "you", speaking to the Babylonian directly, a shift common in the woe sayings (Isaiah 5:8).

decisions.choice: your creditors (B); the people you owe (R)
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable give the sense of the word (m1), since "biters" does not mean creditors in English. Literal keeps the picture. Readable turns the questions into statements.

decisions.choice: the taunt addresses the tyrant as "ngươi"
decisions.reason: The terms note: foreign kings and nations are "ngươi" at every level.

decisions.choice: tu, te, teu for the Babylonian in the woes
decisions.reason: Where the taunt turns from "him" to "you" (m2), every level says "tu", as the prophets speak to a king or a city as one; it continues so through verses 8, 10, 16 and 17.

decisions.choice: "ነካሾችህ" (those who bite you) at Literal
decisions.reason: The Hebrew word means both "biting" and "lending at interest" (m1); Literal keeps the picture, and Balanced and Readable say creditors, as the English levels.

decisions.choice: The taunt turns to address the Babylonian king as "おまえ" at every level (2:7-19).
decisions.reason: The prophetic address rule: おまえ only for taunts against hostile kings and nations (ISA-ISA-1, Isaiah 14, 33:1).

decisions.choice: noshekhekha "おまえにかみつく者たち" (L), "おまえに貸した者たち" (B), "おまえが借りのある人々" (R).
decisions.reason: The word means both 'those who bite' and 'creditors' (m1); L keeps the image, B and R the sense, as the English.

source.text: כִּֽיאַתָּ֤ה שַׁלּ֨וֹתָ֙ גּוֹיִ֣ם רַבִּ֔ים יְשָׁלּ֖וּךָ כָּל־יֶ֣תֶר עַמִּ֑ים מִדְּמֵ֤י אָדָם֙ וַחֲמַס־אֶ֔רֶץ קִרְיָ֖ה וְכָל־יֹ֥שְׁבֵי בָֽהּ׃פ

records.literal_gloss: For you have plundered nations many; they will plunder you, all [the] rest of [the] peoples, because of [the] blood of humankind and [the] violence of [the] land, [the] town and all [who] dwell in it.

en.L: Because you have plundered many nations, \q all the rest of the peoples will plunder you, \q because of [the] blood of humankind and violence [done to the] land, \q [to the] city and all who live in it.
en.B: Since you have looted many nations, \q all the peoples who are left will loot you, \q because of the human blood you shed and the violence against the land, \q against the city and all who live in it.
en.R: You have robbed many nations, \q so the peoples who are left will rob you. \q You killed many people. You were violent to the land, \q to the city and to everyone who lives there.

fr.L: Parce que tu as pillé beaucoup de nations, \q tout le reste des peuples te pillera, \q à cause du sang des humains et de la violence [faite au] pays, \q [à la] ville et à tous ceux qui y habitent.
fr.B: Puisque tu as dépouillé de nombreuses nations, \q tous les peuples qui restent te dépouilleront, \q à cause du sang humain que tu as versé et de la violence faite au pays, \q à la ville et à tous ceux qui y habitent.
fr.R: Tu as volé beaucoup de nations, \q alors les peuples qui restent te voleront. \q Tu as tué beaucoup de gens. Tu as été violent envers le pays, \q envers la ville et envers tous ceux qui y vivent.

es.L: Porque tú has saqueado a muchas naciones, \q todo el resto de los pueblos te saqueará a ti, \q por la sangre de los seres humanos y la violencia [hecha a la] tierra, \q [a la] ciudad y a todos los que habitan en ella.
es.B: Como saqueaste a muchas naciones, \q todos los pueblos que quedan te saquearán a ti, \q por la sangre humana que derramaste y la violencia contra la tierra, \q contra la ciudad y contra todos los que viven en ella.
es.R: Robaste a muchas naciones, \q así que los pueblos que quedan te robarán a ti. \q Mataste a mucha gente. Fuiste violento con la tierra, \q con la ciudad y con todos los que viven allí.

sw.L: Kwa kuwa wewe umeyateka nyara mataifa mengi, \q mabaki yote ya watu watakuteka nyara wewe, \q kwa sababu ya damu ya wanadamu na dhuluma [iliyotendwa kwa] nchi, \q [kwa] mji na wote wakaao ndani yake.
sw.B: Kwa kuwa umeyapora mataifa mengi, \q watu wote waliobaki watakupora wewe, \q kwa sababu ya damu ya watu uliyomwaga na dhuluma uliyoitenda nchi, \q mji na wote wanaoishi ndani yake.
sw.R: Umeyanyang'anya mataifa mengi, \q kwa hiyo watu waliobaki watakunyang'anya wewe. \q Uliwaua watu wengi. Uliitendea nchi ukatili, \q mji na kila mtu anayeishi humo.

vi.L: Vì ngươi đã cướp bóc nhiều nước, \q tất cả những dân còn lại sẽ cướp bóc ngươi, \q vì máu của loài người và bạo lực [đã làm cho] đất, \q [cho] thành và mọi người ở trong đó.
vi.B: Vì ngươi đã cướp phá nhiều nước, \q mọi dân còn sót lại sẽ cướp phá ngươi, \q vì máu người ngươi đã đổ và vì bạo lực ngươi gây ra cho đất, \q cho thành và mọi người sống trong đó.
vi.R: Ngươi đã cướp bóc nhiều nước, \q nên các dân còn lại sẽ cướp bóc ngươi. \q Ngươi đã giết nhiều người. Ngươi đã tàn bạo với đất đai, \q với thành và với mọi người sống ở đó.

ko.L: 네가 많은 민족들을 약탈했으므로 \q 남은 모든 백성이 너를 약탈할 것이다. \q 사람의 피와 [그] 땅에 [행한] 폭력 때문이며, \q [그] 성읍과 그 안에 사는 모든 사람에게 [행한 폭력 때문이다].
ko.B: 네가 많은 민족을 약탈했으니 \q 살아남은 모든 백성이 너를 약탈할 것이다. \q 네가 사람의 피를 흘리고 그 땅에 폭력을 휘둘렀기 때문이다. \q 그 성읍과 그 안에 사는 모든 사람에게 폭력을 휘둘렀기 때문이다.
ko.R: 너는 많은 나라를 털었다. \q 그러니 살아남은 백성들이 너를 털 것이다. \q 너는 많은 사람을 죽였다. 너는 그 땅에 폭력을 휘둘렀다. \q 그 성과 그 안에 사는 모든 사람에게 폭력을 휘둘렀다.

pt.L: Porque tu saqueaste muitas nações, \q todo o resto dos povos te saqueará, \q por causa do sangue humano e da violência [feita à] terra, \q [à] cidade e a todos os que nela habitam.
pt.B: Já que saqueaste muitas nações, \q todos os povos que restaram te saquearão, \q por causa do sangue humano que derramaste e da violência contra a terra, \q contra a cidade e todos os que nela habitam.
pt.R: Tu roubaste muitas nações, \q por isso os povos que sobraram vão te roubar. \q Mataste muita gente. Foste violento com a terra, \q com a cidade e com todos os que vivem nela.

am.L: አንተ ብዙ ሕዝቦችን ዘርፈሃልና፤ \q ከወገኖች የቀሩት ሁሉ ይዘርፉሃል፤ \q ስለ ሰው ደም፣ በምድርም ላይ [ስለ ተደረገ] ግፍ፣ \q በከተማዪቱና በእርሷ በሚኖሩ ሁሉ ላይ።
am.B: ብዙ ሕዝቦችን ስለ ዘረፍህ፣ \q ከወገኖች የቀሩት ሁሉ ይዘርፉሃል፤ \q ስላፈሰስኸው የሰው ደምና በምድሪቱ ላይ ስለ ፈጸምኸው ግፍ፣ \q በከተማዪቱና በውስጧ በሚኖሩት ሁሉ ላይ ስለ ፈጸምኸው።
am.R: ብዙ ሕዝቦችን ዘርፈሃል፤ \q ስለዚህ የቀሩት ሕዝቦች ይዘርፉሃል። \q ብዙ ሰዎችን ገድለሃል። በምድሪቱ ላይ ግፍ ፈጽመሃል፤ \q በከተማዪቱና በዚያ በሚኖረው ሰው ሁሉ ላይ።

hi.L: क्योंकि तुमने बहुत-सी जातियों को लूटा है, \q इसलिए सब बचे हुए लोग तुम्हें लूटेंगे, \q मनुष्यों के लहू और देश [पर किए गए] उपद्रव के कारण, \q नगर और उसके सब रहनेवालों [पर]।
hi.B: क्योंकि तुमने बहुत-से राष्ट्रों को लूटा है, \q इसलिए जो लोग बच गए हैं, वे सब तुम्हें लूटेंगे, \q उस मानव-लहू के कारण जो तुमने बहाया और उस उपद्रव के कारण जो तुमने देश पर किया, \q नगर पर और उसके सब रहनेवालों पर।
hi.R: तुमने बहुत-से राष्ट्रों को लूटा है, \q इसलिए जो लोग बच गए हैं, वे तुम्हें लूटेंगे। \q तुमने बहुत-से लोगों को मार डाला। तुमने देश पर हिंसा की, \q नगर पर और उसमें रहनेवाले हर व्यक्ति पर।

ru.L: Так как ты ограбил многие народы, \q ограбят тебя все остальные племена \q за кровь людей и насилие [над] землёй, \q [над] городом и всеми живущими в нём.
ru.B: Так как ты разграбил многие народы, \q все уцелевшие племена разграбят тебя \q за кровь людей, которую ты пролил, и за насилие над землёй, \q над городом и всеми, кто живёт в нём.
ru.R: Ты ограбил многие народы, \q и поэтому уцелевшие племена ограбят тебя. \q Ты убил множество людей. Ты творил насилие над землёй, \q над городом и над всеми, кто в нём живёт.

ja.L: おまえが多くの国々を略奪したので、 \q 諸国の民の残りの者が皆、おまえを略奪する。 \q 人の血と、地[に加えられた]暴虐のゆえに、 \q 町とそこに住むすべての者[に加えられた暴虐]のゆえに。
ja.B: おまえは多くの国々を略奪したので、 \q 生き残った民が皆、おまえを略奪する。 \q おまえが人の血を流し、この地に暴虐を加え、 \q 町とそこに住むすべての者に暴虐を加えたからだ。
ja.R: おまえは多くの国々から奪った。 \q だから、生き残った人々が、おまえから奪う。 \q おまえは多くの人を殺した。この地に暴力をふるった。 \q 町にも、そこに住むすべての人にも、暴力をふるった。

uk.L: Бо ти пограбував багато народів, \q пограбують тебе всі решта племен, \q через кров людей і насильство [над] землею, \q [над] містом і всіма, хто живе в ньому.
uk.B: Оскільки ти пограбував багато народів, \q усі племена, що залишилися, пограбують тебе, \q через людську кров, яку ти пролив, і насильство над землею, \q над містом і всіма, хто живе в ньому.
uk.R: Ти пограбував багато народів, \q тож племена, що залишилися, пограбують тебе. \q Ти вбив багато людей. Ти чинив насильство над землею, \q над містом і над усіма, хто там живе.

decisions.choice: you have plundered ... they will plunder you: judgment that fits the crime
decisions.reason: The punishment matches the wrong, as in Obadiah 15: "As you have done, it will be done to you". Nahum 2:10 says the same of Assyria. Babylon fell to the Persians in 539 BC.

decisions.choice: the land, the city and all who live in it
alternatives: the land of Judah and the city of Jerusalem
decisions.reason: The words may be general, any land and city that Babylon has ravaged, or they may mean Judah and Jerusalem in particular. The same line closes verse 17.

decisions.choice: one wording at each level here and in verse 17
decisions.reason: The second half of this verse is repeated word for word in verse 17, and it is worded the same way there at each level.
